name: robot_heavy
notes: The robot built heavy in the middle: a round belly that pushes out in front of the chest and wider hips, and thighs three voxels across instead of two. Arms and chest are the robot's own, so the rig is too. One of the three builds a deathmatch bot is drawn as (src/brain/avatar.rs); every build keeps the player's collision box and the chest lamp bands at the same height.
